summary: crates/color-expressions rev4: new tests/vector_graphics_consumer.rs (5 tests) hands resolved expressions (RGB mix, CMYK/gray literals, resolve_paint alpha, a negated mix through a custom palette) to flashtex-vector-graphics's own real downstream types (Item::Rule/PathFill/PathStroke in a DisplayList) and its pdf::content_stream, asserting exact hand-derived PDF operator bytes (rg/G/k, ExtGState ca/CA) survive unchanged. Grepped every crates/*/Cargo.toml: only color-expressions and vector-graphics itself depend on flashtex-vector-graphics; crates/pdf (Paint{rgb:Option<[Decimal;3]>}) and crates/rendering-core (JSON paint{r,g,b,a}) have zero dependency edge and incompatible, non-convertible colour types, so the fixture stops at vector-graphics's own painter surface, per that crate's own 'proposal for later consumer integration, not wired into crates/pdf yet' doc comment, confirmed structurally not just quoted. Measured rev-3's prose gaps: base_palette() covers 9 of xcolor's 19 base named colours (black, blue, cyan, gray, green, magenta, red, white, yellow), missing 10 by name (brown, darkgray, lightgray, lime, olive, orange, pink, purple, teal, violet); the model:components literal accepts 3 of xcolor's 14 documented colour-model identifiers (gray, rgb, cmyk, all core), rejecting the other 11 by name (cmy, hsb, RGB, HTML, HSB, Gray, Hsb, tHsb, wave, named, ps), case-sensitive exact match. No grammar/semantics changed. 92 unit + 16 identity + 5 consumer-fixture + 1 doctest = 114 tests pass; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
